training.disjoint_test_split: test (20 clients per test_sub_list.txt) — untouched by training
training.feature: uniform LBP(8,1) histogram over 80x80 grayscale face crop
training.pickle_to_tflite_parity: max abs delta 1e-9 across inner holdout

msu_mfsd_test.protocol: ISO/IEC 30107-3 — APCER and BPCER computed at equal-error threshold on the held-out MSU-MFSD test split

inner_holdout.note: Inner holdout of the MSU-MFSD TRAIN split only — used during training for calibration. NOT a generalization number; use msu_mfsd_test above for that.

limitations: Trained on MSU-MFSD only — a single corpus of 35 clients captured on 2015-era devices. Expect degraded performance on modern high-DPI displays, OLED phones, and non-English demographics underrepresented in MSU-MFSD.

Layer 4 is one of five defense layers. Do not interpret this model's score in isolation — the SDK orchestrator combines it with Layers 2 (challenge), 3 (rPPG), and 5 (behavioral) before emitting liveness_decision.
HTER 0.289 on MSU-MFSD test is a research-grade number, not a production SLA. Treat the SDK's liveness_decision as a strong signal, not a sole authenticator.
